name: What is the best order for a kitchen renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the best order for a kitchen renovation project?
mainEntity.text: What is the best order for a kitchen renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best kitchen renovation order starts with design and measurements, followed by permits if needed, then demolition, rough plumbing and electrical, inspections, wall repair, cabinet installation, countertop templating and fabrication, countertop installation, backsplash, flooring touch-ups or installation depending on the plan, and finally appliance, plumbing, and lighting trim-out. This order is important because many steps depend on the previous one being completed accurately. Cabinets must usually be in place before countertops are measured, and inspections often must happen before walls are closed up. Homeowners should also order long-lead items early so the project does not stall waiting for cabinets, slabs, or appliances. A disciplined sequence reduces rework, missed inspections, and schedule chaos. For a premium remodel, the contractor should explain the exact project timeline and any special dependencies before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: The usual order is design, measurements, permits, demolition, rough plumbing and electrical, inspections, drywall, cabinets, countertops, backsplash, flooring or touch-ups, then final fixtures and appliances. Ordering materials early is critical because cabinet and stone lead times can control the schedule. Skipping steps often causes rework.
